issuerName: CN Healthy Food Tech Group Corp.

segments.name: Blank check
segments.description: A blank check company seeking to merge with or acquire one or more businesses, currently pursuing a business combination with CFI.
segments.evidence: We are a blank check company incorporated as a Delaware corporation whose business purpose is to effect a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses.

changes.text: In 2024, the company entered into a Share Exchange Agreement to acquire CFI and will change its name to CN Healthy Food Tech Group Corp.
changes.evidence: On September 27, 2024, we entered into a Share Exchange Agreement, which was subsequently amended and restated effective December 18, 2024, by and among Iron Horse, Rosy Sea Holdings Limited, a company incorporated and existing under the laws of the British Virgin Islands ("Seller") and Zhong Guo Liang Tou Group Limited, a company incorporated and existing under the laws of the British Virgin Islands ("CFI") and a wholly owned subsidiary of Seller.
